Los Angeles Critical Mass

Los Angeles, CA · Koreatown · Critical Mass · Social

No-drop

Los Angeles Critical Mass is a Critical Mass ride in Los Angeles, CA. It rolls last Friday of the month at 7:29 pm from Wilshire/Western Metro D Line station. Pace: mass ride; the group says all ages and skill levels. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: mass ride; the group says all ages and skill levels. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @lacriticalmass the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Los Angeles Critical Mass group ride

The last-Friday mass ride out of Koreatown, which calls itself the largest community bike ride in the country at 4,000-plus riders. Gather at Wilshire and Western by 6:30 and roll at 7:29. Every kind of bike; the group says all ages and skill levels. Read the ride rules and the waiver on the site before you come.
